name: Exxxtraterrestrial Experience
source:
You're finally abducted by aliens. They want you to intern in their breeding program to save their species. Four attractive beings will watch over you during that time.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你终于被外星人绑架了。他们希望你在他们的育种计划中实习以拯救他们的物种。在此期间，四个迷人的生物会注视着你。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
